_note: A boss fight's boss (territory.json boss_id). The fight's ordinary waves carry wave_hp of the climb; the boss comes with the site's boss_wave and the fight is won when it dies. hp is times the climb at that wave, the AXIS threat, the planet and the campaign (not wave_hp). It walks the route at speed (world units a second). trick 'jam': every tower within radius (world units; a cell is 2) of it is silenced while it is there. trick 'overload': every interval seconds it charges for charge seconds, then every tower within radius loses tower_share of its full health and BIT within radius bit_share of its own. At the Spire it stays and takes spire_hit_share of the Spire's full health every spire_hit_interval seconds until one of them falls. The wave card warns of it warn_waves ahead. axis_line is what AXIS says when the warning starts ({name}, {waves}), bit_line what BIT says when it arrives. rig is a Data/Towers sheet worn on its back at rig_height, rig_scale times a tower's size. The Arcanist builds a tower called Signal Jammer, so Grid Prime's boss (boss_id signal_jammer, on the site Signal Jammer Core) is named The Silencer.

bosses.name: The Silencer
bosses.what: Every tower within {cells} cells of it goes dark.
bosses.answer: Guns with a longer reach, BIT, the Spire's guns and strikes still hit it, and a stun drops its field. Don't let it reach the Spire.
bosses.arrives: It is on the field. Towers near it are dark.
bosses.axis_line: Directive: a hostile asset designated {name} is {waves} out. It jams company property. Resolve it.
bosses.bit_line: it is loud. the towers near it cannot hear me.

bosses.name: The Overloader
bosses.what: Every {interval} seconds it overloads: towers within {cells} cells lose {tower_pct}% of their health, and BIT {bit_pct}%.
bosses.answer: Repair between bursts, keep BIT out of the ring while it charges (a stun holds the charge), and kill it before the wrecks pile up.
bosses.arrives: It is on the field. Watch the ring: when it closes, towers inside burn.
bosses.axis_line: Directive: a hostile asset designated {name} is {waves} out. It destroys company property. Resolve it first.
bosses.bit_line: it runs hot. what stands near it will not stand long.
